other_types.winner_trifecta_claim: prior claim that EXP21 can neither replicate nor refute

baselines.tansho_umaren: each primary band is compared with its label-free calibrated null: the ticket-weighted mean of 1/overround of each ticket's race, computed from terminal prices only (null_roi_expectation). Statutory takeout is shown for reference only
baselines.takeout_change: JRA takeout for umaren, wakuren and wide changed on 2014-06-07 (recorded in data_manifest); the calibrated null absorbs the change race by race
baselines.fukusho: sqrt(Lo*Hi) is a band-assignment key only and never a payout; settlement uses official payouts; the Stage 1 baseline is the all-ticket pool ROI of the same period and price layer. The Stage 0 power null used synthetic_pay = baseline / q_null (implementation). EXP18 showed that the fixed JRA place formula does not reproduce displayed Lo/Hi (roundtrip Gate FAIL), so Lo/Hi are not inverted to shares or probabilities here

G1.tansho_umaren: discovery D0 vs evaluation D0 primary 10 bands: sign agreement of uplift vs calibrated null >= 8/10 AND Spearman(band ROI) >= 0.70
G1.fukusho: Spearman(band ROI) >= 0.70 is the primary rule; sign agreement vs pool ROI is secondary and does not grade

G2.selection: once, in discovery D0: primary bands with uplift > 0 and bootstrap CI95 lower > 0; union S
G2.test: once, in evaluation D1: uplift(S) >= 50% of discovery D0 uplift(S) AND CI95 lower of evaluation D1 uplift > 0; S empty -> NOT_APPLICABLE
G2.discipline: the discovery D0 table is not reused as formal evaluation; equal ticket-count and fixed bands are secondary and never used for rescue; ROI > 1.0 reported separately; G2 PASS is not a profit edge

v03.dead_heats: excluded per type and counted: tansho 1st-place tie; umaren tie at 1st or 2nd; fukusho number of paid places != places(n); scratched-horse tickets are refunds and not eligible

inference.common_resamples: the same resamples are used for all types and both layers within a period

v03.power_positioning: Stage 0 power used a band-independent normal approximation that ignores the correlation created when one race contributes to several bands; it may be optimistic. Power is a design aid only and is never used as Stage 1 significance
prior_expectations: tansho and umaren: the FLB shape (favorite-band ROI > longshot-band ROI) replicates
fukusho: same direction but flattening in the lowest-odds bands
even where bands exceed the calibrated null, only the favorite-side 1-2 bands, and none reach break-even 1.0
D1: the gradient shrinks because of pre-to-terminal price moves
G1 PASS is not interpreted as a profit edge

final_status.conclusion_ja: 単勝・馬連の等期待的中質量10帯では、最大穴の1帯だけに較正null比−0.13〜−0.27の崖が再現し、残る9帯はおおむね±0.03前後で平坦だった（例外は馬連の帯1 +0.046〜+0.064 と、期間で位置が変わる単勝の帯8または帯9 +0.068〜+0.069。D0）。複勝は帯順位が再現したが、最大穴帯を除いたROIも0.784で、法定参考値0.80と損益分岐1.0の双方に届かなかった。全券種・期間・価格層でROI 1.0超の帯は存在しなかった。
final_status.out_of_scope_ja: 射程外: 枠連・ワイド・馬単はD0記述のみ、三連複は標本不足、三連単は価格源なし、T−10・2024/2025は未検証。
final_status.conclusion_en: In the 10 equal expected-hit-mass bands for tansho and umaren, only the single longest-odds band replicated a cliff of -0.13 to -0.27 versus the calibrated null; the other nine bands were broadly flat around +/-0.03 (exceptions in D0: umaren band 1 +0.046 to +0.064, and tansho band 8 or 9, whose position differs by period, +0.068 to +0.069).Fukusho replicated the band ranking, but ROI excluding the longest-odds band was 0.784, below both the 0.80 statutory reference and 1.0 break-even. No band in any type, period or price layer exceeded ROI 1.0.
